data: Does the blue line  show an overall downward trend as the sentence length increases?

Wait a moment, let me verify this. The blue line represents the relative improvement of the best NMT versus the best PBMT submission on chrF1. Looking at the graph, I can see that the blue line starts at approximately 0.02 for the shortest sentence length range (1-5), then decreases slightly before increasing again in the next range (6-10). After that, the line generally shows a downward trend across all subsequent ranges until it reaches -0.03 for the longest sentence length range (>50). Therefore, yes, the blue line does show an overall downward trend as the sentence length increases.
Yes, the blue line shows an overall downward trend as the sentence length increases.
